text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For this session, she had provided the 
training plan herself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everything went exactly according to my 
plan, down to the millimeter. Thank you 
very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It feels a bit like the first time I 
baked a cake using a recipe I made up 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I ended up getting a little too fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed to have been a wonderful 
experience for Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, due to scheduling conflicts, we 
were unable to carry out the training as 
planned...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's quite alright. It is not as 
though I hadn't anticipated this 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you in the 
future as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From then on, Eishin Flash never again 
offered to create training plans.
